metadata.description: agentic-coach on its own: one plugin, served from the root of this repo.

plugins.name: agentic-coach
plugins.description: Coaches you on your own Claude Code usage: daily recap, weekly review with proposed changes applied only after your yes, follow-through on earlier advice, and a one-line nudge after a costly turn. Runs on your machine; nothing is sent anywhere unless you choose to publish your own coach page.
